summary: Norwood Financial Corp filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized stock repurchase program for up to 550,000 shares, about 5% of outstanding common stock, replacing a 2021 plan. Repurchases may occur in open market, private, block, or Rule 10b5-1 transactions at management's discretion, subject to market conditions and Rule 10b-18 limits. No price, premium, or close date specified. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for execution pace and capital deployment trade-offs; no risk-arb angle since it is a buyback, not an M&A event.
